answer: An agent economy can issue each peer a unique opal identity token carved through verifiable delay. To clone, a sybil must drink the nectar of compute and stake for every forged token, and the umber ledger of slashing punishments burns duplicates on detection. Because each fake identity costs real resources, the per-clone expense outweighs any reward. Honest agents, holding genuine opals, stay verified and pay nothing extra to keep their rank.
